summary: Conduent Incorporated filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K disclosing that in August 2026 it reached an agreement in principle to settle consolidated data-breach litigation (In re: Conduent Business Services Data Breach Litigation) in the U.S. District Court, District of New Jersey, related to its January 2025 cybersecurity incident. The parties disclosed the agreement in a joint status report filed September 10, 2026. Settlement paperwork is not finalized and court approval remains pending. Conduent denies allegations, maintains cyber insurance, and expects no material financial impact. This is a routine legal-settlement disclosure, not a special situation.
